Surah Al Ikhlas (سورة الإخلاص) Read Online

Surah Al Ikhlas is 112 Surah and found in the 30th Parah of the Holy Quran. This Surah contains 4 verses 17 words 47 letters, and it is revealed in Makka so referred to as the “Makki” Surah. And this surah is called The Purity.

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ

قُلْ هُوَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدٌۚ(۱) اَللّٰهُ الصَّمَدُۚ(۲) لَمْ یَلِدْ ﳔ وَ لَمْ یُوْلَدْۙ(۳) وَ لَمْ یَكُنْ لَّهٗ كُفُوًا اَحَدٌ۠(۴)
